title: Entuned | Music engineered for your customer, not the radio
meta_description: Original music tuned to the people who actually walk into your store. PRO-indemnified, plays through any speakers you already have. Free forever, no credit card.

faq.a: Entuned Free is free forever, no credit card. Core is $99 per location per month. Professional is $399 per location per month. Enterprise is negotiated per-location for multi-location rollouts.

faq.q: Do I need new hardware to use Entuned?
faq.a: No. Entuned streams through whatever audio system you already have — Sonos, AirPlay, Bluetooth, line-in, or hardwired. The stream plays from a URL we hand you.

faq.q: What about music licensing — am I covered?
faq.a: Yes. Every track Entuned plays is original, commercial-use cleared, and PRO-indemnified the moment it starts. No ASCAP, BMI, SESAC, or SoundExchange royalties. Every subscription includes a written indemnification certificate.

faq.q: What if I run multiple stores?
faq.a: The Professional tier handles multi-store deployments with POS integration, Outcome Scheduling, and self-improving refinement. For fleets requiring custom ICP design, performance guarantees, or white-glove rollout, the Enterprise tier is negotiated per-location.

faq.q: How do I get started on Entuned Free?
faq.a: Sign in with your email or Google at app.entuned.co/start. No card. You get a player URL the moment you finish — typically under three minutes from sign-up to music in your store.
